h:
自从我开始使用 ComfyUI 以来，我一直看到人们分享他们的工作流程，所以我决定分享我的。此工作流程是为 Pony 设计的，因此可能需要额外修改才能与其他模型一起使用。

如果您收到一条消息，说明有关缺少节点的信息，请转到 ComfyUI 管理器并单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”

无论如何，请随时在此页面的讨论中提出任何问题！享受我的工作流程！ :>

o.en:
Since I started using ComfyUI, I've been seeing people share their workflows so I decided to share mine. This workflow is made for Pony so it may need extra modification to work with other models.

If you get a message saying something about missing nodes, go to the ComfyUI manager and click "install missing custom nodes"

anyways, feel free to ask any questions in the discussion of this page! Enjoy my workflow! :>
